Rounding modes for money
Which rounding mode should a checkout use for sales tax?
Use round half to even on the order total, not on each line. Rounding each line first
is what makes totals drift by a cent, because every tie goes the same way and the
errors add up over many orders.
rust
Copy code
fn order_total(lines: &[Line]) -> Money {
    let subtotal: Money = lines.iter().map(|l| l.price * l.qty).sum();
    round_half_even(subtotal + subtotal * TAX_RATE)
}
Most payment processors round this way already, so the total a customer sees is the
total that settles.
